flora: Mature seed cone (large, heavy sphere with sharply pointed, interlocking scales)
Triangular leaf whorl (thick, leathery, awl-shaped leaves clasping the stem)
Winged seed (flattened, nut-like structure with translucent lateral wings)
Armored bark detail (overlapping geometric plates with a rough, resinous texture)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; chunky, geometric proportions; emphasize the heavy, armored nature of the ancient conifer; textures should feel thick, stiff, and highly tactile.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant layout: Top-Left: a dense, spherical green seed cone; Top-Right: a detailed close-up of the overlapping, sharp triangular leaves; Bottom-Left: a solitary wedge-shaped winged seed; Bottom-Right: a macro study of the geometric bark plates.
visual_logic.ground: A flat, clean surface of fine golden beach sand, serving as a neutral background for the specimen components.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even diffused daylight to bring out the deep greens of the foliage and the rough texture of the cone scales.
